notablePrerequisites: Tergrid's Lantern on the battlefield.Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Attack with Ley Weaver.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and an additional land of your choice.
Repeat step 2 for infinite mana.
Activate Tergrid's Lantern, causing an opponent to lose three life.
Untap Tergrid's Lantern.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for infinite life loss.

uses.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
